Anosmatic.description: You have no sense of smell and are immune to olfactory effects. You lose this immunity if you gain scent.
Anosmatic.name: Anosmatic

Atrophied.description: Your limbs are atrophied. Decrease your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 1. While using your hands to wield any weapon or device whose Bulk is 2 or higher, you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.
Atrophied.name: Atrophied

Change Shape.description: You can transform into a Small, Medium, or Large ancestry you know with any features you choose; for example, you choose your body type, gender, and other details within the normal range for that ancestry. This shape might resemble a specific individual or be completely unique to you. Using Change Shape counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception. You can remain in this shape indefinitely, and you can shift back to your true astrazoan form or another shape by using this action again. If you die while using an alternate shape, your body slowly shifts back to its natural form.
Change Shape.name: Change Shape

Clan Crystal.description: At birth, you're given a one-handed simple weapon crafted with your clan crystal. The crystal can't be removed, and selling the weapon or crystal is a terrible taboo that earns you the disdain of other dwarves.
Clan Crystal.name: Clan Crystal

Cold-Adapted.description: You are naturally acclimated to Akiton's frigid climes. You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Cold-Adapted.name: Cold-Adapted

Constructed.description: Your synthetic body resists ailments better than those of purely biological organisms. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.
Constructed.name: Constructed

Contained Emotions.description: You keep your emotions contained. Creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to [[/act sense-motive]] checks against you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Contained Emotions.name: Contained Emotions

Dermal Hearing.description: You perceive sound through sensitive receptors on your skin rather than their ears. Your hearing is an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, alerting you to the presence, but not the precise location, of creatures within the area.
Dermal Hearing.name: Dermal Hearing

Direct Approach.description: Efficient communication doesn't have time to skirt around the facts with flowery language. You take a −1 circumstance penalty to Deception and Diplomacy checks.
Direct Approach.name: Direct Approach

Emotionsense.description: You gain emotionsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet. You can sense the emotions of creatures that don't have the mindless trait.
Emotionsense.name: Emotionsense

Empathetic Whiskers.description: Your whiskers continuously sense the emotions of those around you, which makes you susceptible to mirroring their feelings. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to Will saves against emotion effects. When you end your turn adjacent to an ally with the frightened condition, you must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:5]. On a failure, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
Empathetic Whiskers.name: Empathetic Whiskers

Energy Wings.description: When in a vacuum, you can manifest butterfly-like wings of pure energy that function as solar sails and enable you to fly through the void of space. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.NEYVJWYtgl0rRSwg]{Manifest Energy Wings} action.
Energy Wings.name: Energy Wings

Epistemological Approach.description: The acquisition of knowledge is above all else the driving principle in your life. If you chose an empirical approach to learning, favoring knowledge through experience, you gain an attribute bonus to Wisdom. If you believe through rational thinking that truths can be known via reason, you gain an attribute boost to Intelligence. You don't get this boost if you choose to take two free attribute boosts instead of your usual ancestry boosts.
Epistemological Approach.name: Epistemological Approach

Fire Breath.description: Your body produces gases that you can expel and internally ignite. You can exhale a @Template[cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[ceil(@actor.level/2)d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic|options:area-effect] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). After using Fire Breath, you can't use it again for [[/r 1d4 #Recharge Fire Breath]]{1d4 rounds}. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.
Fire Breath.name: Fire Breath

Four-Armed.description: You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
Four-Armed.name: Four-Armed

Genetic Adaptation.description: You can reshape and adjust your body to adapt to new situations. You can retrain an ancestry feat in 1 day of downtime, rather than in 1 week. You can retrain any ancestry feat, even lineage feats.
Genetic Adaptation.name: Genetic Adaptation

Gravitational Adept.description: Your innate connection to gravity helps you navigate in treacherous environments. You ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} penalties while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.
Gravitational Adept.name: Gravitational Adept

Gravitational Hands.description: You can direct your gravitational field to manipulate objects and interact with your surroundings. You have two hands with a reach of 5 feet, save that you use gravity to manipulate objects and your surroundings, rather than a physical appendage. These limbs appear as tangible tendrils of energy.
Gravitational Hands.name: Gravitational Hands

Gravitonic Attunement.description: You're attuned to the forces of gravity. You ignore the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} penalties while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity.
Gravitonic Attunement.name: Gravitonic Attunement

Horns.description: Your sharp horns are as deadly as spears. You have a horns unarmed attack that deals 1d8 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the unarmed trait.
Horns.name: Horns

Hydration.description:
Your body requires you to return to aquatic environments or to don armor with environmental protections at least once in a 24-hour period. You must submerge in water in order to rehydrate your water-acclimated skin.

If you fail to do this, your skin begins to crack and your gills become painful. After the first 24 hours outside of water, you take a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves. After 48 hours, you struggle to breathe air and begin to suffocate until returned to water.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.Q5FUu7yhWPJlcXei]{Effect: Dehydrated}
Hydration.name: Hydration

Keen Eyes.description: Your eyes are sharp, allowing you to make out small details about @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or even @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures that others might miss. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus when using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures within 30 feet of you. When you target an opponent that's concealed or hidden from you, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or to 9 for a hidden one.
Keen Eyes.name: Keen Eyes

LFAN.description: You have a raxilite-exclusive biotech augmentation called a Lifting Floret Activation Network, or LFAN, attached to your brain stem. It consists of a cluster of artificial vines that are part mechanical and part biological. Your LFAN grants you a reach of 5 feet despite being a Tiny creature. When used together with your hands, your LFAN allows you to hold items, wield weapons, and Interact with objects as if you were a Medium creature with two hands. This augmentation doesn't count against your total implant limit.
LFAN.name: LFAN

Land on Your Feet.description: You instinctively flex your body midair to ensure you always land on your feet. When you fall, you take only half the normal damage and don't land @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Land on Your Feet.name: Land on Your Feet

Limited Telepathy.description: You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Limited Telepathy.name: Limited Telepathy

Magical Sense.description: Your brain has a specialized organ capable of sensing magical energies. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Magical Sense.name: Magical Sense

Mantle.description: Your petrified shell shields your most vulnerable anatomy. You gain resistance to precision damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Mantle.name: Mantle

Mutant Goblin Mutation.description:
Select one mutation from the list below.

  • Bioelectricity You gain a bioshock unarmed attack that deals 1d4 electricity damage. Your bioshock attack is in the shock group and has the finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.
  • Chromatophores You become trained in Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in Stealth (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} skill feat, except instead of a selected difficult terrain, you can use this feat while adjacent to or within areas of bright artificial light, such as a large neon sign or nightclub.
  • Extra Limbs You grow a second pair of arms. You can select the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.EPeo604ByeeAx3AL]{All Hands on Deck} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.61txGmMLr22B93cU]{Double Draw} standardized ancestry feats.
  • Flight You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet.
  • Gills You gain a swim Speed of 25 feet and can breathe underwater for 1 minute at a time.
  • Limited Telepathy You can communicate mentally with creatures within 15 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
  • Mutant Magic You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} (primal; @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{Caustic Blast}) standardized ancestry feat, except the spell doesn't have the manipulate trait as you hock the glob of acid from your mouth.

  • Suckers You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet.
Mutant Goblin Mutation.name: Mutant Goblin Mutation

Notched Ears.description: Your ears are feathery and notched for finely tuned detection of sound and changes in pressure, often surprising those who thought they were hiding themselves or their machinations. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception checks to [[/act seek]] or for initiative rolls when opposed by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures, or to [[/act sense-motive]] to determine if a creature is verbally Lying. This benefit doesn't apply if you can't hear, or if the other creatures involved are incapable of making sound (for example, if it's affected by a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} spell).
Notched Ears.name: Notched Ears

Oozy.description: You're an ooze! You can Climb surfaces without needing to attempt an Athletics check even if they're perfectly smooth or horizontal, such as a metal ceiling, though the GM might still require you to attempt a check to Climb while in hazardous conditions. Additionally, as long as your individual brains can fit through a gap, your whole body can ooze through it: you can move through a gap at least 2 feet wide without Squeezing and can Squeeze through a gap at least 1 foot wide.
Oozy.name: Oozy

Partner Bond.description: You can form a permanent empathic bond with one willing sapient creature—usually a non-dragonkin. Forming this bond is a one-hour activity that can only be attempted if both you and your partner share a deep emotional bond. You and your partner must remain within reach of each other for the duration of this activity for it to succeed. Once this bond is formed, you can't form another partner bond unless your current partner dies. You and your partner can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet.
Partner Bond.name: Partner Bond

Plant Nourishment.description:
You gain nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match your body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with your roots, or scavenging decaying matter. You typically don't need to pay for food.

If you're photosynthetic, you can absorb energy from natural sunlight or artificial sources like full-spectrum LED lighting. Most starships and settlements have suitable light sources, and flashlights can be modified with LEDs at no cost to replenish your energy with 3 hours of exposure (or 1 hour for a tactical flashlight).
Plant Nourishment.name: Plant Nourishment

Posture.description: You can choose whether to stand or move in bipedal posture, with two limbs on the ground and four limbs as arms, or quadrupedal, with four limbs on the ground and two arms. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L2k363LraGLUZIgM]{Change Posture} action.
Posture.name: Posture

Prehensile Tail.description: You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZwOmHJgVSPbLvC5u]{Prehensile Limbs} (tail) standardized ancestry feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
Prehensile Tail.name: Prehensile Tail

Psychic Reverb.description: Your horn-cones amplify psychic effects—both incoming and outgoing. You take a –1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against mental effects and have weakness to mental damage equal to one quarter your level (minimum 1).
Psychic Reverb.name: Psychic Reverb

Regenerative Evolution.description: Your polyps constantly and passively adapt over time based on your life experiences and goals. You can spend a month of downtime to retrain your copaxi heritage. Additionally, you can perform other downtime activities while retraining, but only while retraining your copaxi heritage, copaxi ancestry feats, initial trained skills, skill increases, or skill feats—not when retraining class features, class feats, and so on.
Regenerative Evolution.name: Regenerative Evolution

Restless.description: You are physiologically compelled to move. Staying in the same place for too long causes you to feel intense fear and even hyperventilate. Unless you are in a moving vehicle, as long as you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} you are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and you do not lower your frightened condition at the end of your turns. Once you are no longer immobilized, reduce your frightened condition by 1.
Restless.name: Restless

Sensory Diversity.description:
All vlakas have a keen sense of smell, gaining imprecise scent with a range of 60 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM might double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, each vlaka is born with one of the following sensory arrays: blind, deaf, deafblind, or hearing/sighted. Select one of these sensory arrays, and gain the associated senses or feats.

Blind: You're blind. You gain hearing as a precise sense with a range of 90 feet.

Deaf: You're deaf. You gain the Read Lips skill feat (even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites).

Deafblind: You're blind and deaf. Your scent becomes a precise sense with a range of 90 feet, rather than an imprecise sense with a range of 60 feet.

Hearing/Sighted: You don't gain any additional senses.
Sensory Diversity.name: Sensory Diversity

Sharp Teeth.description: Your prominent incisors offer an alternative to the fists other humanoids bring to a fight. You have a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile and finesse traits.
Sharp Teeth.name: Sharp Teeth

Six-Armed.description: You have six arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to six hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
Six-Armed.name: Six-Armed

Slime Squirt.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect You can excrete a slick slime that hampers others' movements. One adjacent square within 5 feet becomes difficult terrain for non-osharu creatures for 1 minute.
Slime Squirt.name: Slime Squirt

Solar Luminance.description: You're a miniature sun, bursting with luminance. You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). This ability has the light and primal traits.
Solar Luminance.name: Solar Luminance

Soulfeel.description: Moyishuus are connected to their dominant emotion so deeply that it grants them the ability to project the raw feelings of that emotion. During your daily preparations, choose one of fury, joy, sorrow, and wonder. You become more acutely tuned to that emotion, allowing you to detect creatures feeling that emotion with emotionsense up to 60 feet away. You can distinguish when creatures you detect with emotionsense are experiencing that emotion, giving you a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] against creatures experiencing that emotion.
Soulfeel.name: Soulfeel

Stowaway.description: You can survive long periods clinging to inhospitable surfaces. You add a month to the time before you suffer any penalties from starvation or thirst.
Stowaway.name: Stowaway

Suspended Respiration.description: You're capable of surviving for a limited time in the void of space, suspending your respiration and shielding your body from its dangerous environmental effects. Whenever you enter a vacuum, you temporarily gain the cosmic trait. You have this trait for as long as you remain in a vacuum, up to a maximum of 1 hour. Creatures with the cosmic trait don't need to breathe while in space or a vacuum and are immune to the harmful environmental effects of being in space.
Suspended Respiration.name: Suspended Respiration

Thoughtsense.description: You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense with a range of 20 feet. This enables you to determine when a creature is within range, though this sense detects only thinking creatures; a creature that's unthinking or otherwise immune to mental effects can't be perceived using your thoughtsense. This doesn't give you the ability to read or understand their thoughts.
Thoughtsense.name: Thoughtsense

Verdant.description: You receive a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects, paralysis, poison, or sleep. You don't need to eat, drink, or sleep if you're exposed to natural sunlight for at least 4 hours per day.
Verdant.name: Verdant

Versed.description: You gain the Sign Language skill feat, even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites. If a language you know has a tactile version, you also learn the tactile version of those languages. This means that you know the spoken, signed, and tactile languages associated with all languages you know.
Versed.name: Versed

Vestigial Arms.description: Your four vestigial arms can be used to hold, draw, or stow items of light Bulk, but not to make attacks, wield weapons, or use items.
Vestigial Arms.name: Vestigial Arms

Wasteland Survivor.description: You're accustomed to surviving in Akiton's harsh climates, often going over a week without food. You can survive a number of days without food and water equal to 7 + your Constitution modifier before you begin to starve.
Wasteland Survivor.name: Wasteland Survivor
